storage: Refrigerate at once in a closed box at the coldest shelf and cook within 1 to 2 days, or freeze in portions and thaw in the fridge.
looksLike: Dark red meat cut into small pieces (about 5 to 6 pieces for a 200 g serving in the dish file) with bone attached and a little white fat. Goat meat is sold as "mutton" in India.
howToPick: General guidance, not from a source in this run: fresh meat is pink-red to deep red with white (not yellow or grey) fat, a clean smell and no slime. Ask for pieces cut from shoulder or ribs for rogan josh. Avoid dull, sticky or sour-smelling meat.
shelfLife: About 1 to 2 days in the fridge and a few months frozen (general guidance, not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 200 g bone-in curry cut per serving (about 150 g edible meat; 5-6 medium pieces)
